image_description: A red tractor with a plow attachment is shown in a field. A woman is kneeling beside the tractor, holding a red fuel can. The plow is attached to the rear of the tractor, with visible metal components and soil residue. The background shows a rural landscape with trees, a hill, and some industrial buildings in the distance.
